resolution: The prima via itself defines moving as educing from potency to act (claim AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-REDUCED-BY-A-MOVER-A), and the case reads motus in that broad sense. Aristotle's physical change is one kind of such reduction, so the observation premise STMT-SOMETHING-IS-MOVED-IN-THIS-WORLD holds on either reading. All premises share `MovedIn`/`MovesIn` over an abstract `Respect`, so the formal results hold for any one reading applied throughout; an objection that the regress premises hold only for local motion is an objection to a premise, not an equivocation.
